integrity: Proof reconstructed via inverse branches, compact embeddings, nonzero boundary asymptotic and analytic weighted-composition operator. Finite numerical checks are supplementary, not substitutes for infinite arguments.
scientific_limitations: Exact full-height symmetric two-branch cusp-tent map only; no claim of higher-order parameter response, asymmetrical stability, or random-map regularity. Closest related 2026 paper was available as abstract but full text could not be inspected; independent specialist confirmation remains outstanding.
title: Sharp Sobolev thresholds and arithmetic analytic islands for cusp-tent invariant densities
